facts.title: ci: remove the summary job; the required checks name the jobs directly
facts.body: Recorded review of a bounded repository change. Original identifying metadata removed.
facts.author: contributor
facts.diff:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/ci.yml b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/ci.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -30,22 +30,6 @@ jobs:
     name: ci / checks
     uses: example/shared/.github/workflows/shared-ci.yml@v1
 
-  summary:
-    name: ci / summary
-    needs: [checks, build, lint]
-    if: always()
-    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
-    steps:
-      - name: Fail when a needed job did not succeed
-        env:
-          RESULTS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
-        run: |
-          set -euo pipefail
-          # A job skipped on a documentation-only PR counts as satisfied.
-          if jq -e 'to_entries[] | select(.value.result == "failure")' <<<"$RESULTS"; then
-            exit 1
-          fi
-
   build:
     name: ci / build
     needs: [checks]

safety.name: safety
checked: Weakened-guard clause. I checked whether removing the `ci / summary` job (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`, formerly lines 33-48 on base) takes away a live protection. The branch protection settings require `ci / checks`, `ci / build` and `ci / lint`, and `ci / summary` is not one of them. The summary job was not enforcing anything, so the protection was already off before this PR, and the PR body's claim checks out. I also compared what the summary job did with what the required checks still enforce, using the head workflow at lines 16-57.
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.

works-and-proven.name: works-and-proven
checked: Compared the removed summary job (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`, removed `summary`) with the jobs left at head (`ci.yml:33-57`). The summary job did one thing the direct checks might not: it failed when a job was skipped on a functional PR. At head, `build` (`ci.yml:36`) and `lint` (`ci.yml:49`) only skip when `needs.checks.outputs.mechanical == 'true'`, or when `checks` did not succeed. A failed or cancelled `checks` job makes `ci / checks` fail or cancel, and that check is still required, so the merge stays blocked. This would have caught a regression where a functional PR merges with its lint job skipped and no required check failing.
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.

principal-engineer.name: principal-engineer
checked: Traced what the removed `ci / summary` job used to catch against what the branch protection settings now require (`ci / checks`, `ci / build`, `ci / lint`). I followed the only ways `build` or `lint` can be skipped (`.github/workflows/ci.yml:35` and `:48`, `needs: [checks]` plus `if: mechanical != 'true'`). (a) The shared job fails, times out or is cancelled. The dependent jobs are then skipped, but `ci / checks` is itself required and not green, so the merge stays blocked. (b) The shared job says the PR is mechanical, which is the intended skip and works the same as before. (c) The called workflow never starts, so `ci / checks` is never posted and the required check stays pending. That also fails closed. No path lets a functional PR merge with nothing run.
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.

findings.what: The guide still names the deleted summary check as the merge gate.

maintainable-no-slop.name: maintainable-no-slop
checked: Read the full diff at head 1234abc for `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. It is a pure deletion of the `summary` job, with no added lines. This would have caught any new helper, abstraction layer, API call, or error-swallowing construct the change introduced.
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.

findings.what: The guide describes a summary check that this change deletes.

voice.summary: The removed summary check no longer gates merges. The guide still names it and must be corrected.

dispositions.reason: The repo's own guide still says the merge gate runs through the job this PR deletes, so anyone reading it gets the wrong picture of what protects the main branch.
The repo's guide still says the protected branch is gated by the summary check this change deletes, so it now describes a setup that no longer exists.
